policy: No dataset bytes are redistributed; isolated CI or an explicitly authorized server uses upstream licensed packages. Interface, backend completion and reference agreement are distinct.

benchmarks.data_license: LGPL (pasilla package); inspect installed version metadata and its bundled license
benchmarks.model: public RNAi-treated versus untreated cell samples
benchmarks.independent_unit: sample under vignette design; original study design needs separate review
benchmarks.design: ~ condition; treated versus untreated; all supplied samples
benchmarks.acceptance_scope: fixed tutorial result direction, magnitude and multiple-testing output; not universal RNA-seq validity

benchmarks.data_license: R datasets package GPL-2 or GPL-3; inspect installed version metadata
benchmarks.design: dose 0.5 only; OJ minus VC; unpaired Welch
benchmarks.acceptance_scope: fixed public statistical example and arithmetic/reference agreement; not clinical guidance
